sources.title: Introduction to Techniques Used in Seed1.6
sources.evidence: June 25 technical introduction specifies 230B total and 23B active parameters, sparse MoE, 256K context and multimodal pretraining. It identifies Seed1.6 (Adaptive CoT) separately from Seed1.6-Thinking and links Seed1.6 to doubao-seed-1-6-250615. Full article also retrieved directly.

sources.title: 更强模型效果！豆包大模型 1.6 系列上线边缘大模型网关，最高申领1000万免费 Tokens
sources.evidence: Official Edge Cloud team article explicitly dates the launch to June 11 and names doubao-seed-1.6, thinking and flash separately. HTML metadata dates this retrospective article July 29, 2025. Direct HTML retrieval succeeded after web open timed out.

sources.title: 豆包大模型1.6升级：国内首个原生支持“分档调节思考长度”的大模型
sources.evidence: October 15, 2025 official announcement calls this an upgrade of Doubao 1.6, introducing four thinking-length settings; this is not the original launch.

sources.title: Model list - BytePlus ModelArk Documentation
sources.evidence: Current page and its linked Markdown list seed-1-6-250615 and seed-1-6-250915 with deep reasoning, text generation, multimodal understanding, tool use and 256K context. These entries are retiring; documentation does not establish endpoint operation.

sources.title: Model list - image and video capability rows
sources.evidence: Search-indexed primary page, crawled within a week, explicitly lists image understanding, video understanding and text generation for both seed-1-6-250615 and seed-1-6-250915. Live HTML uses the broader label multimodal understanding; specific modalities are the last indexed documentation.

sources.title: BytePlus Service Specific Terms
sources.evidence: Current HTML defines BytePlus Model Services as its or its affiliates model API services and grants a limited, revocable, non-transferable, non-sublicensable service license. Used with exact Seed API documentation for the descriptive proprietary classification.

sources.title: seed-1.6 - recommended model documentation
sources.evidence: Directly retrieved Markdown identifies seed-1.6 versions seed-1-6-250615 and seed-1-6-250915 and documents the thinking switch; access is through the paid API service.

sources.title: Volcano Engine Edge Cloud author profile
sources.evidence: Identifies the author of the launch retrospective as the ByteDance Edge Cloud technical team, rather than an unaffiliated community contributor.

name.note: Normalized display spelling of Seed1.6 / seed-1.6.

developer.note: Developed by the ByteDance Seed team.

family.note: Seed model series; standard Adaptive CoT variant.

release_date.note: Earliest public Doubao-Seed-1.6 launch; June 25 is the technical introduction and October 15 a later upgrade. Research article links the Seed name to the Doubao API.

open_weights.note: Published as a proprietary API model; no Seed1.6 weight release is provided by these official sources.

license.note: Descriptive classification of restricted API access, not an SPDX or open-weight license.

parameters_b.note: Nominal billions explicitly reported for Seed1.6 pretraining.

active_parameters_b.note: Nominal active billions explicitly reported; not copied from Flash.

context_window.note: Published as 256K tokens; 256000 is a decimal normalization of this nominal capacity, not an independently verified exact token boundary. It refers to context rather than maximum input alone.

modalities.note: Exact standard-model rows support text generation and image/video understanding; specific visual modalities use indexed primary documentation.

reasoning.note: Adaptive reasoning variant; thinking can be enabled or disabled in documented versions.

tool_call.note: Tool use explicitly listed for the standard dated versions.

description.value: ByteDance multimodal MoE model with adaptive reasoning, a 256K context window, and tool calling.
description.note: Replaced generic instruction-following wording with directly documented features.

patch.notes: The original Doubao-Seed-1.6 launch was June 11, 2025; June 25 is the Seed technical-introduction date and October 15 an upgrade. Parameter counts describe the standard 230B/23B Seed1.6 foundation, not Flash. Capabilities are documented specifications, not a live endpoint test. Context 256000 is the decimal normalization of the provider’s nominal 256K specification.

summary: Corrected original launch to June 11, 2025; added directly disclosed 230B total, 23B active and MoE architecture, and proprietary classification. Confirmed 256K context, reasoning, tool use and documented text/image/video input with text output. Distinguishes later upgrade and technical-introduction dates; specific visual modalities rely on indexed primary rows.
